item.title: Russian drone and missile barrage kills at least 12 in Ukraine’s Kyiv
item.description: Russian attacks escalate as EU defence ministers meet in Ireland to discuss Ukraine air defence shortages.

item.description: A price cap increase is on the way, the latest blow to people already struggling with rising costs.

item.description: Many Iranians inside the country feel they are being unjustly erased from the international community.

item.description: Israeli ministers escalate campaign rhetoric with AI ads as Gaza strikes widen ahead of tight October election.

item.title: Algeria’s president seeks death penalty for those who start forest fires
item.description: Abdelmadjid Tebboune's call comes after wildfires killed at least 12 people and injured 54 in northeastern Algeria.

item.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
item.description: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

item.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
item.description: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.

item.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
item.description: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several injured at a techno rave in Aarau.
